comment: User allow-list for the public demo roster (read by tools/demo-roster.mjs, never by the page). The public demo offers ONLY finished characters: shipped in docs/CHARACTER_STATUS.md, or a final independent critic verdict that ships recorded in characters/<id>.md (score >= the CHARACTER_PLAYBOOK ship bar, no blocking zeros). Put a characters/<id>.js id in 'allow' to offer it publicly anyway (the user's call, e.g. "allow": ["mushroom", "frog"]); then re-run tools/remote.sh node tools/demo-roster.mjs --browser. It must still load, idle and walk. Work in progress stays reachable with demo.html?wip=1.
userDecision: 2026-10-16: user chose 'All cast that work': offer every character that loads, idles and walks, without WIP badges, except the one cast member the user skipped (see pipeline/skip.txt). Add new working cast members here too.
